title: French Chickpea Pancakes
description: Delicious French-style pancakes made with chickpea flour and topped with a tangy sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the chickpea flour, fluffy, and salt.
Add the dutch and tangy to the bowl and whisk until smooth.
Add the pancakes and mix until combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter into the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the edges start to dry.
Flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve hot with your favorite toppings.
